scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
A paradise on the sea,
beautiful waves and warm sunshine.
^8B4513Moscovia^000000 is waiting for you.
I'm supporting to offer information about here.
If you want to ask anything just feel free tell me.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞嚮導]
海上樂園，碧波盪漾，陽光和煦。
^8B4513莫斯科比亞^000000正等待著您。
我負責介紹這裡的情況，有問題儘管問。

scripts.text:

[Moscovia Guide]
The ^0000FFKafra Employee^000000 has
been marked on your mini-map
Check your mini-map.
Do you need anything else?

請檢視小地圖。
還需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
In the <NAVI>[Palace]<INFO>moscovia,255,140,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> you will find our Lord the Czar and other servants.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:

在<NAVI>[宮殿]<INFO>moscovia,255,140,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>，您可以見到我們的君主沙皇以及其他侍從。
還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

<NAVI>[Moscovia P.R. Officer]<INFO>moscovia,166,53,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> at the docks if
